residual_R9_before_issuance.title: Per-source source_access_accounting slots from C4B's template are absent from the warrant candidate
residual_R9_before_issuance.what_c4b_froze: C4B's 07_UNSIGNED_SOURCE_WARRANT_TEMPLATE.json carries, for each of the seven fresh-read sources, a source_access_accounting block with seven placeholders: full_file_sha256_passes = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; path_opens = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_BASIS; decoder_invocations = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; metadata_header_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; selected_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_CONFIG; full_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_CONFIG; retries = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_REASON. Four of the seven therefore carry an extra qualifier: path_opens requires a stated basis, selected_reads and full_reads require a stated config, and retries requires a stated reason.
residual_R9_before_issuance.what_the_candidate_has_instead: A single global bound_globals-level access_accounting_instrumentation_bound with a 10-item accounts list, basis_required_per_figure true, and a digest_publication_requirement. The per-source REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT slot structure is gone from the warrant instrument itself.
residual_R9_before_issuance.why_it_matters: O1-C06 requires the warrant to bind 'operations/columns/read limits' per source. Read limits are per-source quantities. Per-source expected counts do exist, but in artifact 07_EXECUTION_ACCOUNTING_AND_FAILURE_LAW.json, not in the warrant that actually authorises the reads.
mitigating_factors: The substantive accounting law is not lost; it is frozen in artifact 07 with per-source expected_full_reads, expected_selected_reads, expected_metadata_reads and expected_header_prefix_bytes.
Artifact 07 also carries the measurement-basis rule and the explicit warning that a bare count of opens is meaningless.
The stop law in artifact 07 does reference the per-source operation classes.
residual_R9_before_issuance.why_still_a_repair_and_not_merely_adviso: The warrant is the instrument that binds what a future executor may read. If the per-source limit slots are absent from it, an executor holding only the warrant has no per-source read-limit field to comply with, and O1-C06's read-limit binding is not satisfied by a cross-reference to another document.
residual_R9_before_issuance.required_repair: At issuance, restore the per-source source_access_accounting block for all seven sources with the seven exact-count slots and their basis/config requirements, populated or bound to the frozen expectations in artifact 07.
